panel.title: Shopping assistant
panel.intro: Describe what you are looking for in your own words — an ingredient, a health goal, or a price range — and the assistant will find products from the catalog.
panel.placeholder: What would you like to find?

reply.noCriteria: I could not match that to an ingredient, goal, or filter. Try rephrasing — for example an active ingredient, a health goal, or a price range.
reply.empty: No products matched your request. Try broadening the criteria or rephrasing.
reply.medicalStop: For a question like this, please consult a physician or pharmacist. I would be glad to help you find products from the catalog.
reply.turnLimit: This conversation has reached its length limit.

errors.rateLimited: Too many messages in a short time. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.unavailable: The assistant is unavailable right now. You can use the regular search.
errors.network: Sending failed. You can try again.

a11y.responseArrived: A new reply from the assistant arrived
